notes.title: Development update #3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Exciting news from the Noodle Party universe! We are thrilled to announce that we have completed the development of special items. We created them to enhance the gameplay and provide you with even more tools. You will encounter three different gadgets:

[h3]The Magnifier[/h3]
With this special item, you can choose the topic for your next question. Select your favorite category to increase the odds of knowing the answer or explore new subjects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659531/3e52c8e677eaecb7dea32e720d60133037ae0fc2.gif[/img]

[h3]The Halver[/h3]
Reduce the chances of making mistakes with the Halver! When a question stumps you, use this gadget to eliminate two wrong answers. Increase your odds of success when you're unsure of the correct response.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659531/1b414d1c019044e39082a0b2ca034b23d8b8aa45.gif[/img]

[h3]The Swapper[/h3]
Change your strategy with the Swapper! If you don't know the answer to the given question, don't worry! Simply use this gadget to swap the question with another from the same category. Gain another chance to answer correctly and score points!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659531/4150e5e3b55316bcd9a90cba52c4bae86be06b62.gif[/img]

You can acquire these gadgets during mini-games, but you can only have one of each. Therefore, you need to manage them wisely to make the most out of your gameplay. We believe that these special items have successfully achieved the goal of making the game more exciting. We can't wait for others to try out the end result. :)

notes.title: Development update #2
notes.notes:
As the year is progressing, we are back with an update about our love project! The start of the year was especially eventful for us, as we moved to a new flat. This took up most of January. But now that everything is in order, we are back to developing Noodle Party in our free time! 

[h3][u]First mini game is ready[/u][/h3]
Since the last post, we've finished our first mini game, created a common UI structure for all the future ones, and finalized all the related systems! We are really happy how everything turned out, especially the UI. We think it's really good to look at. Simple yet informative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659531/75a43fa245ed1d79013e2c1482fbd4b6be4e703f.gif[/img]


[h3][u]Navigation in menu improved[/u][/h3]
We made some adjustments to our menu system based on feedback. As you may know, we decided to do a rather unconventional menu system that is in 3D space. While it's much more interesting than a conventional 2D system, this may not be as straight forward for some. 
We feel that the improvements definitely helped in this regard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42659531/4679606de16111fe61019b66ba33aeee4561eb7d.gif[/img]


[h3][u]Gems -> Special items[/u][/h3]
In the coming months, we are targeting to finish the "special item systems". ( Formerly known as gems. ) These are items that one can gather during the Tower Challenge mode. Later to be used in one's turn to help if there is a tough situation. 

Also, we are working on other mini games and adding more questions to the quiz pool!
We will be back with an another update soon!


The Noodle Party team

notes.title: Development update 1
notes.notes:
As promised, here we are with a development update!
Quite a lot has happened since our last post.

[u][b]Game update[/b][/u]
With most of the base systems ready, we turned our gaze to the last main thing missing.
The Tower Challenge Mode will have mini-games between the rounds. These games will vary
in style and task. In one such mini-game you will have to use your reflexes to get ahead
of your opponents in another, you will have to use your wits.

These can turn the tide quite often, since not only will you be able to gain additional points 
but you can hoard special gems! These can grant you special abilities in your turn, for 
example, the next question you answer correctly will give you double points. Use them wisely!

[u][b]Kickstarter[/b][/u]
We are hard at work on our Kickstarter campaign too. Most of the graphical elements are done and
the sections are coming together nicely. The next big step is the video. We have drawn up several
sketches and agreed on one to make it to the finals! We are really excited about the campaign, 
as it would help us a great deal in making the game better and speed up the development process by a great deal.

Regards,
The Noodle team
